captcha.sdk_load_failed: Failed to load the Aliyun captcha SDK. Check your network and refresh the page.
captcha.hint_ready: Click "Start verification" to solve it in a real browser; if a slider appears, complete it manually in the popup.
captcha.hint_running: Invisible verification in progress: usually completes within seconds without any popup; a slider only appears if risk control demands a second check — complete it manually in the popup.
captcha.too_many_attempts: Still failing after several retries. Please wait before clicking "Start verification" again
captcha.hint_attempts_exhausted: Verification failed repeatedly. You may retry later; if it keeps failing, check your network or switch your egress IP.
captcha.submitted: Verification result submitted; usable by JWT requests for about 45 seconds
captcha.hint_submitted: Submitted. A captcha result is short-lived; repeat the verification once it expires.
captcha.hint_submit_failed: Verification passed but the submission failed. Click "Start verification" again.
captcha.hint_verify_failed: Verification did not pass; the SDK retries automatically. If nothing happens for a while, click "Start verification" again.
captcha.title: Human verification
captcha.subtitle: When automatic solving is blocked by risk control, complete the Aliyun invisible captcha manually in a real browser; the result is reused for JWT account requests
